config.rationale: Substantially upgraded compact_transformer. Round-1 used hidden=48 (only 12 per head) which is severely under-capacity for modeling pathology texture. Now hidden=128 (32 per head with 4 heads), depth=3 (was 2), mlp_ratio=4 (was 3). Weight decay raised to 0.01 (standard for AdamW transformers) to prevent attention weight blowup. Class weighting enabled (was off) to address imbalance. Label smoothing increased to 0.1 for better calibration on 9 classes. LR reduced to 3e-4 (from 5e-4) since the larger model is more sensitive to LR spikes in early training. Attention pooling retained as it outperformed mean/cls in round 1. Patience=3 to allow convergence. The conv tokenizer (patch_size=4, tokenizer_layers=2) produces 49 tokens of dim 128, giving the attention layers sufficient spatial context while staying under 4M params.
